title: Sinus floor elevation using a sintered, natural bone mineral - A histological case report study
authors: Rothamel D, Smeets R, Happe A, Fienitz T, Mazor Z, Schwarz F, Zöller J. Zeitschrift für zahnärztliche Implantologie, 2011; 27(1):60.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “It was concluded that BEGO Oss acts as an osteoconductive material to support hard tissue regeneration after sinus floor elevation. Showing excellent volume stability, it is integrated into newly formed bone matrix within a six-month healing period. *Study refers to BEGO Oss and BEGO collagen membrane, which are private labels of cerabone® and Jason® membrane” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
